task:
Open Obsidian with the vault at /home/user/Documents/EditorVault. Using the Obsidian Settings dialog, configure the following editor settings:

1. Enable 'Spell check' (the spellcheck toggle in Settings > Editor)
2. Enable 'Strict line breaks' (strictLineBreaks)
3. Disable 'Readable line length' (readableLineLength)
4. Enable 'Fold heading' (foldHeading)
5. Enable 'Fold indent' (foldIndent)
6. Enable 'Show line number' (showLineNumber)

After changing all settings, close the Settings dialog.

cli_feasibility.translation: 直接编辑 .obsidian/app.json 文件，设置 spellcheck=true, strictLineBreaks=true, readableLineLength=false, foldHeading=true, foldIndent=true, showLineNumber=true
